csv_project_name: Engineering for Weirs Beach Endicott Rock Park Wave Baffle
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Laconia is seeking professional engineering guidance for the design of adjustable wave baffles at Endicott Rock Park (Weirs Beach} on Lake Winnipesaukee. Weirs Beach is a man-made beach that was engineered and constructed in the 1950s by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers. Originally, the beach sand extended from the jetty along the navigational channel to the docks. Over time, sediment has migrated down the channel and settled near the Naswa Beach Resort, resulting in significant loss of sand from the Endicott Rock Park beach area.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
